title: ADscan scan summary v1
description: scan_summary.json: the outcome and timing of one scan: whether the goal was met, whether a domain was compromised, how long that took and how many attack paths the report states. Durations are measured on a monotonic clock, so they stay correct when the host clock is stepped to a domain controller during the scan. Written by one writer (write_scan_summary in adscan_internal/services/scan_outcome_telemetry.py). Version marker: schema_version, '1.<minor>'; a file without it was written before the contract existed (ADscan 14.0.0 and earlier). Declared objects may gain fields within a major; do not reject unknown keys. Carries no secret.

path_state.$comment: Most advanced path lifecycle state reached: theoretical, foothold_obtained, post_ex_in_progress, domain_compromised.

flags.$comment: Lab capture flags found (user, root, system); presence only, never the value.
